core_obligations: Take the closures of the given closed subsets in the total space and spread them to a neighbourhood.
Show that over a nonempty open the traces of the closures still cover every fibre.

proof_roadmap.step: Form the closures of the closed subsets.
Check the covering property persists fibrewise.

difficulty_reason: For a finite type morphism over an irreducible base, a covering of the generic fibre by finitely many closed subsets spreads to a covering of every fibre over a nonempty open, comparing each fibre with the closures of the given subsets. The proof takes the closures of the closed subsets in the total space, spreads them to a neighbourhood using finite type, and then checks that over a nonempty open their traces still cover each fibre. Keeping the covering property while spreading is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 6668-6683.
